notes.title: Sandtrix 3.0
notes.content:
Combometer now displays the time left for the current stack of score instead of the overall combo time 
 If the combo is on x10 no more stacks are added, score is instead added onto the existing x10 stack 
 Flash on drop piece can now be disabled in the options
 Escape now also pauses the game
 JDK updated to 22

notes.title: Sandtrix 2.9
notes.content: Fixed an error where the game crashes upon loading an old save file

notes.title: Sandtrix+ 2.9

notes.title: Sandtrix 2.9

updated engine

Retry/Menu screen on gameover

notes.title: Sandtrix+ 2.5
notes.content:
stacks: fixed a bug where removing a stack did not count combo score
stacks: decreased stack reduce score
stacks: clear now only reduces 1 stack, but combos reduce multiple
adjusted some map effects
grind visual effect (can be disabled in options)
highly improved rubberbanding (reduces chance of unlucky runs)
slightly decreased combo delay
menu: moved back button to left corner
menu: missing soundfx added

notes.title: Sandtrix 2.4
notes.content:
Happy new year!

New game mode: "Stacks" - maximum stars increased to 60
New feature: 14 unlockable effects
New unlockable theme
Visual improvements
JVM Option: -DskipMenu=true/false - skip menu, run game with last settings
JVM Option: -DlogGameInfo=true/false - logs information about the last played game as CSV to stdout
JVM Option: -DlogBenchmark=true/false - logs benchmark related output in intervals to stdout

notes.title: Sandtrix+ 2.3
notes.content:
